items.performers: The Philadelphia Orchestra; Yannick Nézet-Séguin, conductor
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: The E minor symphony that Frederick Stock introduced with the Chicago Symphony in 1933, paired on this album with the Third, so that the changes between the 1933 breakthrough and the Detroit work can be heard side by side. It is a good first recording of Price’s orchestral music. The linked video contains the complete first movement.

items.work: My Soul’s Been Anchored in the Lord
items.performers: Marian Anderson, contralto, with piano accompaniment
items.label: Sony Classical / RCA Victor
items.note: Price’s spiritual arrangement sung by Anderson, one of her most important advocates. Disc 1 of Beyond the Music contains two recordings of the song, alongside Anderson’s European recital repertoire.

items.label: Chandos
items.note: The third movement is a Juba; the fourth is a quick Scherzo. The quintet is scored for piano and four strings. The complete quintet occupies tracks 5–8 of American Quintets.
